title: Seventeenth stale-suite triage draw, filed under P3 item 26: ranks 1-20 of the verdict-aware ranking, 20 directories, 20 drawn files, each executed, verdicts only
idNote: Recorded under the standing P3 item 26 rather than a new T id: T-400..T-599 and T-700..T-799 are exhausted and the T-800+ range is an owner decision. Precedent: item 26 draws 7, 15 and 16.

scope.drawnFrom: governedRiskRanking ranks 1-20 of docs/architecture/test-ci-coverage-census.json on the base, first drawable path of each directory. 0 critical and 0 high remain, so all 20 are band unclassified.
scope.everyFileWasExecuted: Each file was run on its own with npx jest --runTestsByPath <file> --no-coverage --ci --json on the base. Counts are what jest reported, never read from the census.
scope.reachability: Every subject was resolved from the test imports and checked against docs/architecture/unreachable-components.json (orphans) and docs/architecture/orphaned-lib-modules.json (testOnly, unreferenced). Each wiring row subject was also confirmed imported by a non-test file.
scope.liveCorpus: Two rows read tenant data through process.cwd(), both from legacy dataset roots deleted on 2026-07-13; they join the draw 16 data-lane decision. Two further red rows build inline fixtures against tenant identities the product has since retired; their updates are test-only and need no data decision.
scope.readOnly: No workflow, baseline or test file is changed by this record. The census is regenerated so the 20 files are held out of the next draw with their verdicts published.

secondHalf.what: Wire the wire_into_ci rows, each re-executed on the then-current main first. The two fixture re-key updates (ranks 8 and 13) are claimable as test-only changes. The two repair rows wait on the draw 16 data-lane decision. The five T-775 rows stay held until their owner acts.

Not repaired and not wired here.
